portability_findings.issue: D:/Blender/blender.exe is workstation-specific. Configure installed Blender 5.2.2 LTS-compatible executable. Do not upload Blender program.
Codex runtime absolute paths. Node launcher has PATH fallback; Sharp module path must be changed or provided through normal local dependency resolution.
Machine-specific metadata; install_to_game=false. Do not infer permission to read/write game directory.
C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc optional China-text font input. Existing mesh/source needs no installed font to preview; rerun requires available substitute or configurable font path.
Old parent build/high_hoop/deps sys.path insertion. Remove/ignore when Python environment includes compatible numpy and Pillow; do not silently ship environment.
Preview freshness compares IFF size and mtime to manifest. Git checkout changes mtime; export_native_preview.py may need rerun or portable hash-aware check despite identical bytes.
Build requires published source GLB/manifest inputs; wait for watcher export after changing config/source. Intermediate must pass repair_iff.py before game output.
Parser rejects duplicate keys, never silently rewrites them. Binary floor SCNE uses separate BinaryScene decoder.
